evidence.citation: “Re-run all golden cases—A, B, and C—with one fresh, context-free runner per case… B now passes… A and C still pass… The live checkout is inspected afterward and any cross-run leaks are removed.”
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: Re-running B validates the targeted fix, while re-running A and C checks for regressions. Fresh isolated runners and the post-run leak inspection are necessary integrity and reproducibility controls explicitly protected by the cost bar.
